audit.whatIsWrong: QA lint pass: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit; dosFull[1].d was verbatim tradeGood and dontsFull[2].d verbatim tradeBad (COPY_PASTE_BLEED).
audit.why: Kit: Veigar E Event Horizon 20/18.5/17/15.5/14s — the 20s rank-1 number makes the mirror cage-trade advice concrete.
audit.corrected: Cooldown digit added from champ-data/_kits/veigar.json; dos/donts rephrased so they no longer duplicate the trade fields verbatim.

edits.before: - Veigar Event Horizon (Cage): matchup-defining — Only the cage EDGE stuns — hold position near the center or leave before it forms; never dash into the wall. Check it before every step-up. - E Event Horizon (self-cage) is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Veigar Event Horizon (Cage, 20s at rank 1): matchup-defining — Only the cage EDGE stuns — hold position near the center or leave before it forms; never dash into the wall. Check it before every step-up. - E Event Horizon is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.

edits.before: Cage his step-up, W the edge-stun, Q-auto, and walk — a half-bar trade that also deposited three stacks into the curve.
edits.after: Cage first when he steps up, W the edge-stun, Q-auto, then back off — you win the half-bar trade and bank three stacks.

edits.before: W-ing open ground on a moving target and trading uncaged 'just to stack' — Veigar without the wall is a piggy bank with a hat.
edits.after: W-ing bare ground at a moving target, or trading with your cage down 'just to stack' — no wall makes you a piggy bank with a hat.
